Research

Published studies concerning marine environments and human impacts.

01

Mercury in dried market fish

Published · First author · 2022

A study examining mercury in 81 dried fish samples from Hong Kong and San Francisco, published in the *Journal of Asian Health*.

02

Marine megafauna and tuna fisheries

Published · Coauthor · 2022

A spatially explicit risk assessment of marine megafauna vulnerability to Indian Ocean tuna fisheries, published in *Fish and Fisheries*.

Connecting fieldwork, research, and design

My work brings together experience in product design, underwater research, and scientific publishing. I'm interested in ecological change, deep time, and how people participate in thriving ecosystems across generations.
